rows.note: This is the all-purpose one for cutting or attacking with the teeth, including an animal or insect physically biting.

example.english: I got a bite from a dog.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 zek3 gau2 ngaau5 can1 laa3

rows.note: Use 啖 as the all-purpose noun for one mouthful, and in food contexts for the small amount meant by “a bite to eat.”

example.english: I’ll have one more bite before I go.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 do1 jat1 daam6 sin1 zau2

rows.note: Use 小食 when “a bite” means a snack or light food rather than one mouthful.

example.english: We’ll have a bite to eat before the movie tonight.
example.traditional: 夜晚睇戲之前，我哋食啲小食先。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 tai2 hei3 zi1 cin4 ngo5 dei6 sik6 di1 siu2 sik6 sin1

rows.note: Use 咬傷 for the injury or wound left by an animal or person biting someone.

example.english: I have a bite wound on my hand, and it’s still bleeding.
example.traditional: 我隻手有道咬傷，仲流緊血。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 jau5 dou6 ngaau5 soeng1 zung6 lau4 gan2 hyut3

rows.note: Use this specifically when an insect stings or bites someone, rather than when an animal bites with its teeth.

example.english: I got a bite from a mosquito at the park yesterday.
example.traditional: 尋日去公園畀蚊叮咗一啖。
example.jyutping: cam4 jat6 heoi3 gung1 jyun4 bei2 man1 deng1 zo2 jat1 daam6

rows.note: Use this for holding something in the teeth or, in mechanical contexts, for a hook, tyre, or anchor gripping firmly.

example.english: This suction cup gets a firm bite on the glass.
example.traditional: 呢個吸盤咬住塊玻璃，好穩陣。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kap1 pun4 ngaau5 zyu6 faai3 bo1 lei4 hou2 wan2 zan6

rows.note: Use this when a fish takes bait and gets hooked, or when a person falls for a lure or deceptive offer.

example.english: The fish took the bait with one bite and got hooked.
example.jyutping: tiu4 jyu4 jat1 ngaau5 nei6 zau6 soeng5 diu3 laa3

rows.note: Use 𧕴 specifically for the swelling or mark caused by an insect bite, especially a mosquito bite.

example.english: I’ve got a mosquito bite on my leg.
example.traditional: 我隻腳畀蚊叮到起咗個𧕴。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 bei2 man1 deng1 dou3 hei2 zo2 go3 naan3
